source:
@@U02294@@
Then hurry! You wont slip away this time! Prove your blathering lies are true! Show us these noble chambers, now! I'll lay down my sword and scepter and dig with my own imperial hands and finish the job. And if it’s a lie, I'll send you to Hell.
translation:
@@U02294@@
那就快点吧！这次你不会再溜了！证明你的谎言是真的！现在就向我们展示这些高贵的房间！我会放下我的剑和权杖，用我自己的帝国之手来挖掘并完成工作。如果这是谎言，我会把你送进地狱。
